CreateMemo dispatches the memo.created webhook even when invoked from CreateMemoComment. The relevant code is located at lines 156–158 in memo_service.go.

Comment creation triggers both `memos.memo.created` and `memos.memo.comment.created` webhooks. The memo service fires the former for the comment creator. The comment service fires the latter for the memo owner. Only SSE is suppressed during this flow. No webhook suppression context was found.

No webhook suppression was found.

`CreateMemo` dispatches `memos.memo.created` to the comment creator's webhooks. `CreateMemoComment` dispatches `memos.memo.comment.created` to the related memo owner's webhooks. All three lifecycle events converge through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` in `memo_service_webhooks.go`, which calls `webhook.PostAsync` for final delivery.

`DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` bypasses `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and calls `webhook.PostAsync` directly. `webhook.PostAsync` enqueues to `asyncPostQueue`. Four worker goroutines in `init()` consume the queue and invoke `webhook.Post`. `webhook.Post` performs the actual HTTP POST via `safeClient.Do(req)`.

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` fires from `CreateMemo` at `memo_service.go:157`. `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` fires from `UpdateMemo` at `memo_service.go:513`, `SetMemoAttachments` at `memo_attachment_service.go:48`, and `SetMemoRelations` at `memo_relation_service.go:48`. `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` fires from `DeleteMemo` at `memo_service.go:562`. `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` fires from `CreateMemoComment` at `memo_service_comments.go:119`.
